«وقالت زينب سمعت أم سلمة، تقول» : the chain is Zaynab, then Umm Salama, who relays the Prophet's ruling

«قال حميد فقلت لزينب ... قالت زينب» is Humayd's own first-person account of asking Zaynab, with no isnad of its own: implicit transmission, set for ruling (rule 11). Humayd is not written as a link above Zaynab
«قال مالك تفتض تمسح به في حديث محمد» and «قال مالك الحفش الخص» are a wording remark and a gloss: left out

fixes.reason: HKG places حميد بن نافع above زينب in the chain; the text writes Humayd only as the one who asks Zaynab in the second part, and the written chain opens at زينب.
